fraseFuncional: Is today Tuesday? No, it is Saturday. It is the weekend.

estaciones.learningOutcome: Can recognize familiar words related to days of the week spoken slowly. / Can respond to the basic days of the week and weekend by pointing at the word or position on a basic calendar.

candados.instruccion: Escucha el audio y responde: ¿qué día es hoy?
candados.textoAudio: Today is Tuesday. Yesterday was Monday.
candados.pistaCodigo: Toma la primera letra de la respuesta correcta.

candados.textoAudio: Is today Wednesday? No, it is Thursday.

candados.instruccion: Escucha y cuenta cuántas veces se menciona 'Tuesday'.
candados.textoAudio: Tuesday, Tuesday! Today is Tuesday. I like Tuesday!
candados.pregunta: How many times do you hear 'Tuesday'?
candados.pistaCodigo: El número es un dígito del código.

estaciones.learningOutcome: Can find and point to familiar words in simple texts. / Can identify and follow one-step written directions with visual support.
